Report Title: Open GenAI Models Proven Secure for Enterprise Adoption, New Evaluation Shows
Finding: In LatticeFlow AI's enterprise security evaluation of five open foundation models, DeepSeek R1 had the weakest baseline security score of any model tested at 1.8%, rising to 98.6% once a dedicated input-filtering guardrail layer was added.
